title_en: Artificial Intelligence (17/20): Algorithms on the Stock Exchange
note_en: 哪怕……也…… means "even if... still...": 哪怕系统再聪明，也不能完全代替人的判断 "even if the system gets smarter, it still can't fully replace human judgment." The concession word 哪怕 opens the first clause, and 也 must appear before the verb in the second; English "even if" needs no partner word, but in Chinese leaving out 也 sounds wrong. The text also shows the shorter 算法再厉害，也离不开…… "however powerful the algorithm, it still can't do without..."
